title: BOMP - Best Optization Mods Pack
description: BOMP - the best minecraft optimization pack for MORE and BETTER fps
body:
**BOMP** - is a carefully curated optimization modpack designed to dramatically improve performance in Minecraft without changing the core gameplay experience. Whether you're playing on a low-end PC or just want smoother gameplay, BOMP helps you get higher FPS, faster loading times, and better overall stability.

This modpack focuses purely on performance enhancements, including rendering optimizations, memory usage improvements, and engine-level tweaks. No unnecessary features, no gameplay changes - just clean, efficient Minecraft.
